CommitRefJson.description: Ref decoration attached to a commit in JSON output.

Person.description: A parsed identity line (`Name <email> <epoch> <tz>`) for stable `--json` output.

date.description: Author or committer timestamp in RFC 3339.

RevsCommit.description: One listed commit: the shared commit shape plus `--left-right` / `--cherry-mark` marks.

change_id.description: Stable change id (reverse-hex; stored header or derived from commit id).

change_id_stored.description: `true` when `change_id` came from a `change-id` commit header.

equivalent.description: With `--cherry-mark`: a commit on the other side has the same patch-id.

equivalent_to.description: With `--cherry-mark`, for a one-to-one equivalent pair: the other side's commit.

message.description: Full message body with trailing whitespace trimmed.

message_changed.description: With `--cherry-mark`, for a one-to-one equivalent pair: whether the messages differ.

refs.description: Ref decorations (branches, tags, `HEAD`, …) for this commit.

relative_date.description: Relative author date (e.g. `3 days ago`), when `now` is supplied.

side.description: Side of the symmetric range, with `--left-right` or `--cherry-mark`.

RevsLeftRightCount.description: Left/right counts for a symmetric range (`--left-right --count`).

RevsSide.description: Which side of a symmetric range (`A...B`) a listed commit is on.

oneOf.description: Reachable from the left tip only.
Reachable from the right tip only.

commits.description: Listed commits in `rev-list` order (empty when `--count` is set).

count.description: Total reachable commits when `--count` is set without `--left-right`; otherwise `null`.

left_right.description: Left/right counts when `--count` and `--left-right` are set; otherwise `null`.

next.description: Continuation cursor when the list is resumable; always `null` for `revs` today.

truncated.description: True when more commits matched than returned (`-n`).
